notes.title: Historical update records before the official version release
notes.content:
23.12.2206 Version
1. Fix the default font of the PC version.
2. Failure to fix Endless mode will result in infinite failure.
3. If the number is an infinite cycle number, only the first integer is displayed.
4. Symbol changes will now try to show calculated changes.
5. Make the endless mode display in the Settings match the Super mode in the Settings
6. Synchronized the display solution when using the change scroll in the props.
7. The permissions of store and display solution super mode are synchronized
8. Each situation of the synchronized display solution will be used normally
9. Increased the amount of gold earned in Endless Mode.
10. Delete the archive system and wait for the reset. The current archive system can cause bugs in subsequent updates.

Current known problems
1. Filing system
2. Beginner tutorials

23.12.23 07 08 version
1. Added Endless Mode maximum level record.
1. Set the default window startup for PC deployment.
2. Made a new archiving system.

23.12.23 Version 09
1. Fix a minor issue with the archive system.
2. Reset progress button added
3. Fixed the reset progress button causing the default endless mode to answer 1 question correctly
4. Endless mode novice guide production.
5. Add the version number
Current known problem
1. Figure
2. Beginner tutorial
3. There may be a BUG if the display is turned on in endless mode
4. Producer information is not added
5. The main menu in the Settings menu is not cleared
6. The maximum record update is always 1 less in Endless mode
